selection_reason: Keep Oct for ordinary queries, use Quad alone for eager sums, and release Oct after lazy sum preparation. No size threshold. Keep cold Quad helpers out of the hot Oct caller. Native-only forced inlining had no consistent benefit.

from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import random
import statistics
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
focused = bool(os.environ.get('WM_FOCUSED'))
cache = root / ('.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_sum_focused' if focused else '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_adaptive')
cache.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
flags = ['-std=gnu++23', '-O2', '-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero', '-DATCODER', '-DONLINE_JUDGE', '-march=native']
source = root / 'test/benchmark/wavelet_matrix_opt.cpp'
lock = open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w')
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {2})

@contextmanager
def exclusive():
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)

variants = {}
for name in ('before', 'current', 'sum_focused' if focused else 'adaptive'):
    folder = cache / name
    (folder / 'data_structure').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / 'components').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if name == 'before':
        header = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '523956f:data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp'], cwd=root)
    elif name == 'current':
        header = (root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_adaptive_source.hpp').read_bytes()
    else:
        header = (root / ('.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_sum_focused_candidate.hpp' if focused else '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_adaptive_candidate.hpp')).read_bytes()
    (folder / 'data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp').write_bytes(header)
    for component in ('quad_bit_vector.hpp', 'oct_bit_vector.hpp'):
        code = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '523956f:components/' + component], cwd=root) if name == 'before' and component == 'quad_bit_vector.hpp' else (root / 'components' / component).read_bytes()
        (folder / 'components' / component).write_bytes(code)
    binary = folder / 'bench'
    with exclusive():
        subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-I', str(root), '-DWM_OPT_HEADER="' + str(folder / 'data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp') + '"', str(source), '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
    variants[name] = {'binary': binary, 'header_sha256': hashlib.sha256(header).hexdigest()}

data = {'measured_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'baseline': '523956f', 'compiler': subprocess.check_output(['g++', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0], 'flags': flags, 'affinity': [2], 'trials': 3, 'warmup': 1, 'cases': [], 'sources': {name: {p.name: p.read_text() for p in (cache / name).rglob('*.hpp')} for name in variants}}
cases = [(n, mode, op) for n in (200000, 500000, 1000000) for mode in (0, 1, 7) for op in ('kth', 'freq', 'small', 'eager', 'prepare')]
if os.environ.get('WM_QUICK'):
    cases = [(n, mode, op) for n in (200000, 1000000) for mode in (0, 1, 7) for op in ('kth', 'freq', 'small', 'eager')]
if focused:
    cases = [(200000, mode, op) for mode in (0, 1, 2, 7) for op in ('eager', 'prepare', 'small', 'large')]
    cases += [(1000000, mode, op) for mode in (0, 1, 7) for op in ('eager', 'prepare', 'small')]
    cases += [(n, mode, op) for n in (200000, 1000000) for mode in (0, 1, 7) for op in ('kth', 'freq', 'count')]
    if os.environ.get('WM_FOCUSED_QUICK'):
        cases = [(n, mode, op) for n in (200000, 1000000) for mode in (0, 1, 7) for op in ('kth', 'freq')]
rng = random.Random(20261019)
for n, mode, operation in cases:
    samples = {name: [] for name in variants}
    checksums = set()
    with exclusive():
        for trial in range(-1, 3):
            names = list(variants)
            rng.shuffle(names)
            for name in names:
                raw = subprocess.check_output([str(variants[name]['binary']), str(n), '50000', str(mode), '0', operation, '64', '81917'], text=True)
                row = json.loads(raw)
                checksums.add(row['checksum'])
                if trial >= 0:
                    samples[name].append(row['ms'])
    assert len(checksums) == 1, (n, mode, operation, checksums)
    entry = {'n': n, 'mode': mode, 'op': operation, 'width': 64, 'q': 50000, 'seed': 81917, 'samples_ms': samples, 'median_ms': {name: statistics.median(values) for name, values in samples.items()}, 'checksum': checksums.pop()}
    print(json.dumps(entry), flush=True)
    data['cases'].append(entry)
    (cache / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
